-- Check the total number of rows in the final query
WITH 
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as cnt,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, role) as rn
        FROM player_match
        GROUP BY player_id, role
    ) sub
    WHERE rn = 1
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, SUM(bms.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bms ON bbb.match_id = bms.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bms.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bms.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bms.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
player_balls AS (
    SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_balls
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as total_matches
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),
player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, bbb.match_id, SUM(bms.runs_scored) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bms ON bbb.match_id = bms.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bms.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bms.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bms.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
player_highest AS (
    SELECT player_id, MAX(match_runs) as highest_score
    FROM player_match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_milestones AS (
    SELECT player_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_30,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_50,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_100
    FROM player_match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_wickets AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN wicket_taken w ON bbb.match_id = w.match_id AND bbb.over_id = w.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = w.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = w.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler
),
player_bowling_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, SUM(bms.runs_scored) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bms ON bbb.match_id = bms.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bms.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bms.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bms.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler
),
player_balls_bowled AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY bowler
),
wickets_per_match AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, bbb.match_id, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN wicket_taken w ON bbb.match_id = w.match_id AND bbb.over_id = w.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = w.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = w.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
),
runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, bbb.match_id, SUM(bms.runs_scored) as runs_given
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bms ON bbb.match_id = bms.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bms.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bms.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bms.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT w.player_id, w.wickets, COALESCE(r.runs_given, 0) as runs_given,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.player_id ORDER BY w.wickets DESC, COALESCE(r.runs_given, 0) ASC) as rn
    FROM wickets_per_match w
    LEFT JOIN runs_per_match r ON w.player_id = r.player_id AND w.match_id = r.match_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON p.player_id = pr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_matches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON p.player_id = pd.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_highest ph ON p.player_id = ph.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_milestones pms ON p.player_id = pms.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_balls pb ON p.player_id = pb.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_wickets pw ON p.player_id = pw.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_bowling_runs pbr ON p.player_id = pbr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_balls_bowled pbb ON p.player_id = pbb.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bb ON p.player_id = bb.player_id AND bb.rn = 1;

# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.
